correctness.rationale: The Fourier characters on Z_m×Z_n diagonalize the 8-shift operator, with multiplier 4(cos(theta)+cos(phi))(2cos(theta)cos(phi)-1), verified by summing all eight unit/two displacements. Factor one vanishes on theta±phi=pi modulo 2pi; each congruence, when L=lcm(m,n) is even, has gcd(m,n) solutions. Their intersection contains exactly (pi,0) if m even and (0,pi) if n even, giving 2g 1_(2|L)-1_(2|m)-1_(2|n). For factor two, the rational-angle cosine relation cos(theta+phi)+cos(theta-phi)=1 is exhausted by Conway–Jones (1976) Theorem 7, including endpoint cases, yielding angle types (0,±pi/3), (±pi/3,0), (pi,±2pi/3), (±2pi/3,pi), plus 8 cases from {±pi/4}² union {±3pi/4}². Their availability counts are 2 for each listed 6-divisibility condition and 8 when both sides divisible by 8. The two factor-zero sets are disjoint because v=-u implies uv≤0. This gives the exact stated kernel dimension; both odd iff zero; for any even side 2g-1_(2|m)-1_(2|n)≥1. Square case follows by substitution. Independent direct complex-frequency enumeration matched the formula on 667 rectangular sizes, including dimensions up to 100 and both resonances; finite enumeration is not the proof for unbounded m,n. The cited Conway–Jones external rational-angle theorem was read and is a genuine stated premise, not replaced by a verifier log.
